name: Imagery
summary: Makes pictures from a description with the image service you choose, keeps them in a gallery you can search, and holds back at a daily limit you set. Practice, the default, sends nothing anywhere.
author: The JimmyHQ project

owner_hosts.purpose: Reach the image server you choose, if you use one of your own that answers the way OpenAI's image service does and has a public https address. (One on your own network is added on this page instead.)
owner_hosts.next: Then choose Your own server as the image service and type its address in this app's settings.

tools.name: recent
tools.description: Lists the pictures the owner made lately with Imagery, newest first. Each has its number, when it was made, which image service and model made it, its shape, whether the owner starred it, and the description it was made from. The description is the owner's own words, shown as written. The pictures themselves, any key and any address are not given.

limit.description: How many pictures to list, from 1 to 25. Leave it out for 10.

secrets.name: gemini_key
secrets.label: Gemini key
secrets.help: Only if you use Gemini: make a key in Google AI Studio and copy it here. Practice and Your own server need none.

secrets.name: compatible_key
secrets.label: Key for your own server
secrets.help: Only if your own server asks for one. Typed beside its address under Your own addresses. Leave it empty if your server needs none.

secrets.name: own_network_key
secrets.label: Key for a server on your own network
secrets.help: Only if the server on your own network (an http:// address, or one with a port) asks for one. Leave it empty if it needs none. Over http the key crosses your network unscrambled, so use a key made for this alone.

settings.label: Image service
settings.help: Practice draws a labelled placeholder on this computer and sends nothing, so you can try everything. Gemini is Google's, and needs its key and a Google account with image quota. Your own server is one you name below.

settings.label: Gemini model
settings.help: The model's name as Google gives it. Google renames and retires image models, so change this if Gemini says the model is not found.

settings.label: Gemini picture size
settings.help: Larger pictures cost more and take longer. The model's own default is 1K. Not every model offers every size.

settings.label: Your server's address
settings.help: Up to its version part. Public: https://images.example.com/v1, its host also added under Your own addresses. Your own network: http://192.0.2.10:8000/v1, with http://192.0.2.10:8000 first added under Addresses on your own network (Settings, Apps, Imagery).

settings.label: Your server's model
settings.help: The model name your server expects.

settings.label: Sizes your server takes
settings.help: One per line: a shape, an equals sign, then the size in pixels, such as 3:2=1536x1024. Only these shapes are offered with your own server.

settings.label: Ask your server for the picture itself
settings.help: Imagery asks for the picture as text inside the answer, which most servers need. Turn this off if your server refuses that request, as OpenAI's newer models do, since they always answer that way.

settings.label: Picture shapes to offer
settings.help: One per line, written like 16:9. Gemini takes 1:1, 1:4, 4:1, 1:8, 8:1, 2:3, 3:2, 3:4, 4:3, 4:5, 5:4, 9:16, 16:9 and 21:9; a shape it does not take is left out when you use it.

default: Photo: a realistic photograph, natural light, sharp focus
Watercolour: a soft watercolour painting with gentle washes of colour
Line drawing: a clean black ink line drawing on white paper
Flat illustration: a flat illustration with simple shapes and no gradients
settings.label: Style endings
settings.help: One per line as a name, a colon, then the words added to the end of your description, such as Photo: a realistic photograph. You choose one, or none, when you make a picture.

settings.label: Most pictures in one go
settings.help: How many pictures one request may ask for, from 1 to 4. Each one counts against your daily limit.

settings.label: Pictures a day with an outside service
settings.help: Imagery refuses to ask an outside service for more than this in your day, counted from midnight in your time zone. Every request counts, even one the service refused. Practice does not count.

settings.label: Most pictures to keep
settings.help: Over this, the oldest pictures you have not starred are deleted for good, and Imagery says so. Starred pictures are never deleted this way.

settings.label: Most space for pictures (MB)
settings.help: Over this, the oldest pictures you have not starred are deleted for good. Keep it below the app's storage line under Settings, Apps, which is 500 MB to begin with.

settings.label: Longest description (characters)
settings.help: A longer description is refused before anything is sent.

settings.label: Wait for the service for (seconds)
settings.help: How long Imagery asks one request to take; Gemini may need up to 3 minutes. JimmyHQ never waits longer than "Longest wait for an app's network request (seconds)" under Settings, Apps, advanced (20 to begin with): raise it to 180 if pictures time out.

settings.label: Largest starting picture (MB)
settings.help: A picture you give Gemini to change is sent inside the request, so it is kept small. A larger one is refused before anything is sent.

settings.label: Pictures on a page of the gallery
settings.help: How many pictures the gallery shows before Show more.
